name: player_update_vertical_velocity_and_transform
description: Player::UpdateVerticalVelocityAndTransform finalizes vertical projectile velocity, applies slope forces, clamps upward velocity, and refreshes local velocity from the motion basis.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player post-move environment cluster pass so _ftol damping bits, upward x87 clamp, and in-place motion-basis projection shape can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42c2e0 validates measuredFrameDeltaY from worldPos.y minus previousTransform.posY times g_Player_InvDeltaTime, direct Y commit for at least three above-ground probes, damping blend otherwise, AccumulateSlopeForces, strict >55 upward clamp to zero, attachment early return, projectileSpawnVel-to-localVel motion-basis projection, and localVel.y zeroing for at least three probes.
The native smoke verifies the damped vertical blend, local velocity projection, direct full-support vertical path, upward clamp, and full-support local Y zeroing.
